item.title: Tonko wants to abolish ICE over shootings, economic damage
item.description: Rep. Paul Tonko of New York called for the end of ICE, citing deadly shootings, economic damage, and a violation of the Constitution, and argued that the agency is out of control and has lost the public trust.

item.title: Teachers' union sues over Long Island charter schools
item.description: The New York State United Teachers union has filed a lawsuit to block the opening of three new charter schools on Long Island, alleging that SUNY ignored community opposition and financial threats to public school districts.
